lines.say: Friday, 6 PM. You change one letter, and two minutes later your whole app is down.
lines.show: Friday, 6 PM. You change *one letter,* and 2 minutes later your whole app is [down.]

lines.say: The change went straight to users. Nothing stood in between to catch the mistake.
lines.show: The change went *straight to users.* Nothing stood in between to catch the [mistake.]

lines.say: C-I-C-D is the automatic safety net between your code and your users.
lines.show: *CI/CD* is the automatic *safety net* between your code and your users.

lines.say: First, it builds the app. Build fails? It stops.
lines.show: First, it *builds* the app. Build fails? It [stops.]

lines.say: Then automated tests check that features like login still work. A test fails? It stops again.
lines.show: Then *automated tests* check that features like login still work. A test fails? It [stops again.]

lines.say: Everything passes? The update is ready to release, automatically or with one-click approval.
lines.show: Everything passes? The update is *ready to release,* automatically or with one-click *approval.*

lines.say: So that one-letter typo? If the build or a test catches it, your users never see it.
lines.show: So that one-letter typo? If the build or a test *catches it,* your users [never see it.]

lines.say: If AI writes your code, follow for the system design it leaves out.
lines.show: If AI writes your code, *follow* for the system design it leaves out.
